name: Tokyo Disneyland Hotel
description: The most prestigious hotel at Tokyo Disney Resort — magnificent Victorian palace physically connected to the park entrance with direct walkway access. Stunning castle views from upper-floor rooms and unmatched Disney character theming throughout.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant Victorian-styled room with Disney character decor, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Castle View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with direct views of Cinderella Castle — the ultimate Tokyo Disneyland experience.

rooms.name: Character Room
rooms.description: Specially themed room featuring Disney characters throughout the decor with exclusive amenities.

name: Disney Ambassador Hotel
description: Glamorous Hollywood golden age hotel celebrating Disney animation heritage — Mickey-themed suites, art deco ballroom and two themed restaurants. Free shuttle to both parks.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Art deco styled room with Disney animation artwork, free WiFi and en-suite bathroom.

rooms.name: Character Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite themed around Mickey and friends with separate living area and premium amenities.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Larger deluxe room with upgraded Disney theming and premium bedding.

name: Tokyo Disney Resort Toy Story Hotel
description: Colourful family hotel themed around Andy room from Toy Story with cheerful character rooms and giant toy installations. Most popular choice for families with young children.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Cheerful Toy Story themed room sleeping up to 3 guests with Disney character decor.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger Toy Story room with extra space for families with young children.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Spacious family room sleeping up to 4 guests with full Toy Story theming.

name: Tokyo Disney Celebration Hotel
description: Budget-friendly Disney hotel with Wish and Discover wings — cheerful Disney theming at accessible prices. Free shuttle to both Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea.

rooms.name: Wish Room
rooms.description: Dreams-come-true themed room in the Wish wing with Disney decor and free shuttle access.

rooms.name: Discover Room
rooms.description: Adventure themed room in the Discover wing with Disney decor and free shuttle access.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Larger room in either wing with upgraded furnishings and extra sleeping space.
